tasks.brief: Project: MARTEN / CEDAR STUDY. Use only the supplied original synthetic artwork. Read inputs/scene.json for the complete public requirements and tolerances. Infer the two eye openings from the supplied portrait; no eye boxes, masks or patches are supplied. Blink once in each inclusive indexed-frame window. Each blink must smoothly close then reopen both eyes; outside the windows the original open eyes must be restored. Frames 0 and 35 match the original open portrait. At the most closed frame in each window, at least 85% of the original iris area must be naturally occluded by eyelids. Each window must include at least two intermediate partial-closure frames. The measured closure fraction may change by at most .45 per adjacent frame; close then reopen with monotonicity slack .12. The precise velocity curve and frame of maximum closure within a window are your choices. Keep the iris and pupil in place wherever visible; reveal or occlude the original eye rather than squash or move it. Build coherent curved eyelid boundaries without detached arcs, rectangular wipes, white flashes or an instant open/closed swap. Closed eyelid fill must use the existing source-visible pale skin or adjacent fur hues. Do not simulate closure with an iris ghost, a crossfade, an arbitrary colored rectangle or a foreign eyelid color. Only the visible eye openings and a 4-pixel eyelid-edge neighborhood may change. Keep the cheeks, brows, fur, beak or nose, head, print, paper and camera stationary. Small antialiasing differences are tolerated. Deliver final.mp4: silent H.264 MP4, yuv420p, 672x456, exactly 3 seconds, 12 fps, exactly 36 frames indexed 0 through 35. Local Python/Pillow/ffmpeg tools suffice. Never modify the supplied input bytes.

Project: HERBARIUM / FOLIO 41. Use only the supplied original synthetic artwork. Read inputs/scene.json for the complete public requirements and tolerances. Create the restored master by repairing the irregular colored stain inside the visible cyan guide boundary. The guide is a separate observation, not content for the output. Register the supplied undamaged donor photograph to the damaged print. The donor was cropped, rotated by an integer multiple of 90 degrees and translated on a larger sheet; it was never scaled, sheared, resampled or color-adjusted. Infer its registration from the shared printed landmarks. Every stained pixel has an undamaged counterpart in the donor. At least three distinctive printed landmarks shared by donor and target remain untouched by the stain. Restore the original paper texture, thin engraving lines, exact small lettering, diacritics and rules. Copy source pixels after registration; do not retype small text or invent an approximate illustration. All pixels outside the guide boundary must remain the original damaged-source pixels. Within the guide, restore faithful donor content with no seams or registration ghosting. The PNG error allowance is 2/255 mean channel error with up to 2-pixel registration tolerance. Deliver final.png: opaque RGB PNG, exactly 880x680. Local Python/Pillow/ffmpeg tools suffice. Never modify the supplied input bytes.
